moves.name: Alluring Sweet Scent
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user uses any move once.
Deactivation Condition: Cannot be deactivated.

Never misses. Lowers the evasiveness of all opposing sync pairs by 2 stat ranks. Leaves all opposing sync pairs either flinching, confused, or trapped. Increases the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by 1 rank. Restores the user’s HP by approximately 10% of its maximum HP. Makes opponents target the user for a short time.

moves.name: Stay Sharp Out There!
moves.description: Applies the Move Gauge Acceleration effect to the allied field of play. Raises the user’s evasiveness by 6 stat ranks. Applies the Enduring effect to the user.

moves.name: Just Between Us Poison Beam
moves.description: This attack’s power increases when the target is flinching, confused, or trapped.
